headline: Solex Energy Urges India to Subsidize Domestic Solar Production Amid China Export Curbs
summary: Solex Energy's chairman called on the Indian government to incentivize domestic solar manufacturing and diversify supply chains as China considers restrictions on technology and component exports.
why: India is deploying tens of gigawatts in clean energy capacity to meet national decarbonisation goals. Dependency on Chinese photovoltaic component manufacturing creates geopolitical and supply-chain vulnerabilities for renewable developers.

impacts.name: Solar Energy
impacts.why: Potential government incentives to counter export curbs would bolster domestic module manufacturing capacity.
